messages:
lina: dropped a quick mock for the playground run history + tool-output labels. trying to address confusion when multiple tools emit structured JSON. link: https://figma.redwood/app/xyz (view only)
kevin: saw it — nice. main question: are these labels dynamic based on the function name or a human-friendly alias?
lina: dynamic by default (function name), but we show an alias when provided. thinking of a hover that shows full signature + schema.
jamal: quick nit: the default function name is often camelCase and looks weird in the UI — maybe we should auto-prettify (split camel case, replace underscores)
maria: agree with jamal. Also: copy for the collapsed tool line reads "tool output" — can we make it clearer like "Tool output (structured)" or "Tool output — schema attached"? users skim.
lina: good call. options: 
- "Tool output — parsed fields"
- "Tool output — schema attached"
- "Tool output (structured)"
which feels clearest?
kevin: prefer "Tool output — parsed fields". conveys that we parsed it. shorter maybe "Parsed tool output"
jamal: accessibility angle: ensure the collapsed line has role="button" + aria-expanded and a visible focus ring. from earlier tests keyboard users couldn't expand easily.
a11y-bot: Automated check: contrast issue detected on the small grey meta-label (timestamp) — WCAG AA fail for 12px on #6b7280 over white. Recommend darker shade or bolder typography.
maria: thanks bot. Lina can we raise that to #374151 or bump weight to 600?
lina: will update. also debating whether run-history rows should show 1-line preview of the top-level result field when schema exists, e.g., "message: order accepted". keeps list scannable.
kevin: 1-line preview is useful but might leak PII. need to sanitize or offer a toggle to hide previews for orgs with strict data rules.
jamal: yep — add a per-workspace setting: "Show tool previews in history" default on for new orgs. log access in audit.
lina: added to the ticket. UX question: where to put the schema badge? inline on the right, or under the tool name? inline keeps row compact but pushes timestamp.
maria: inline right-aligned as a small pill works for me. ensure pill is keyboard focusable and has aria-describedby with "Open schema" tooltip.
kevin: copy for that pill: "schema v1"? or "schema • 3 fields"?
lina: idea: show version when multiple, else show field count. e.g., "schema" or "schema • 3 fields". clicking opens inspector.
jamal: +1. also let's include a small copy tweak in the schema inspector header: change "Fields" to "Structured fields" — less ambiguous for non-devs.
maria: final copy tweak: in the tool-call modal, change "Return type" to "Output schema" — customers kept asking what return type meant.
kevin: great. can we get a short copy doc with all these strings so translations can start?
lina: I'll compile a copy doc and post here by EOD.
a11y-bot: Reminder: keyboard order test required after changes. Tagging @eng-qa to run smoke.
jamal: pinged them. if they fail we'll roll back the pill interactivity to mouse-only until fixed ( :( ).
lina: thanks everyone, i'll push an updated figma and a tiny PR with colors + copy by tomorrow morning :thumbsup:
